annotation_integration: Integrator owns Ghidra names/comments, exports, reconstruction/name ledgers and CMake; proposals are hypotheses, and existing comments/library names must be preserved.

api.domain: SingletonLifetimeDomain with mandatory actual-owner deleting callback and returning invalid-parameter callback
api.publication: Domain retains one volatile pointer; getter returns captured pointer, no publication lock; shutdown clears only after destroy/free.
api.projected_owner: system_owner().native_owner is the concrete manager; section_10 refers to its same real owned Win32 critical-section projection.
api.projected_counter: Counter is actual owned lock+18h storage; manager lock/unlock adjusts it; free section helper functions do OS calls only for particle adapter.
api.allocation: singleton_lifetime_allocate({kind,native_bytes,host_bytes}) returns raw malloc(host_bytes) storage; actual _callnewh retry; matching free; no zeroing or alternate heap.
api.registered_destruction: Mandatory noexcept callback(context,exact registered owner,flags1); manager pop precedes callback; owner decides its actual unregister/free behavior.

existing_build.boundary: New source separately compiled/linked; CMake integration belongs to primary.
